root_idea.summary: The root denotes removing something from over or before something else, thereby exposing what was concealed.
root_idea.development: Its semantic development extends from physically uncovering or stripping away a covering to making hidden things apparent, relieving distress, and related forms of disclosure, withdrawal, and exposure.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Public citation form for the Quranic active participle.
Feminine inflection of the active participle citation form كاشف.
Plural inflection of the active participle citation form كاشف.

senses.definition: To remove harm, affliction, grief, or adversity; to lift distress.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with an affliction or other distress as the object of removal; Quranic contexts commonly present the lifting of harm as an act of divine relief.

senses.definition: To remove a covering; to uncover, expose, or make what was concealed apparent.
senses.usage_conditions: May refer literally to taking something off or away from over another thing, or figuratively to bringing a concealed matter into view.

senses.definition: In يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ, to have the shin uncovered; idiomatically, for extreme severity or crisis to become manifest.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a Quranic idiomatic construction. Its explanation is associated with the disclosure of a severe situation, while the reported etymological interpretations differ.

senses.definition: Removal or taking away, especially the lifting of harm or adversity.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun naming the act or result of removing what causes distress or prevents relief.

senses.definition: One who removes or takes away harm or affliction; a remover.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participle may be used substantivally and in plural or feminine inflection, and may function predicatively with the sense “one who will remove.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To discover, detect, reveal, or disclose something hidden.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form I use concerned with bringing concealed information or a hidden matter to light, distinct from the physical removal of a covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To investigate, explore, scrutinize, search, examine, or inquire into something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Constructed with عَنْهُ; it denotes directed inquiry into a matter rather than simply removing a covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act openly or frankly toward someone; by extension, to show open enmity or wage war openly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III construction; مُكَاشَفَةٌ may denote frank openness, while constructions with enmity or war specify overt hostility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appear or become manifest to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction كَاشَفَ عَلَيْهِ, with the sense of appearing to or becoming apparent to him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become acquainted with, know, or gain knowledge of what was concealed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or recipient-oriented construction referring to becoming informed about a hidden matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Discovery or revelation of hidden matters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun or technical nominal use for disclosure or revealed knowledge; its plural is مُكَاشَفَاتٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To uncover or expose oneself while sitting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V reflexive bodily-exposure usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reveal faults or secrets to one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction involving mutual disclosure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw, recede, or become removed from someone or something, including from over it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or quasi-passive Form VII construction describing the disappearance or withdrawal of a covering, thing, or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be routed, defeated, or put to flight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive or quasi-passive Form VII usage, especially in descriptions of defeat.
A passive participial adjective describing something laid open or publicly apparent.
An agent noun for one who discovers or reveals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A whorl or circular patch in the forelock; in horses, a twist in the tailbone or tail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical or zoological term describing a feature as though hair were exposed from its point of growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who has no shield with him in war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical description associated with exposure in battle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For lightning to spread through or fill the sky.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form V usage understood through the idea of becoming exposed or conspicuous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Successive offspring, one birth following another; also, a female left unbred for two or three years.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal-breeding term with two reported related applications.

cautions: The Quranic expression يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ is idiomatic and has more than one reported explanation; it should not be treated as an ordinary physical uncovering without noting its severe-crisis interpretation.
